maria_cs: Heads-up: Aster Bio (large pilot) asked for a focused enablement sprint — migrations + cost ops. Renewal touchpoint in ~3 weeks; CS + Solutions want two 90-min sessions next week. Who can lead/co-train?
leila_enable: I can co-lead. CET afternoons work best for me. Prefer Wed/Thu.
ajay_solutions: I can cover Wed 11:00 PT (8pm CET) or Thu 10:00 PT. Which looks better for Aster?
sam_engineer: I can take the Dedicated migration deep-dive + labs. Prefer Thu morning PT.
maria_cs: Need hands-on labs: 1) model pinning & canary rollouts 2) autoscale policy tuning 3) cost baseline + quantization recs. Proposal: Wed = 90m "Migration & Rollout", Thu = 90m "Cost & Ops". Agree?
leila_enable: Agree. Recommend we send a 1-pager prep doc and require a sandbox account only (no prod creds).
ajay_solutions: I'll spin up a quick poll after we confirm trainers. @ops-bot can you surface current seats/org health info for Aster?
ops-bot: ops-bot: Found 6 active seats and 2 pending invites for Aster Bio (org-582). Last activity: infra API calls 3 days ago. Link: https://internal.redwood/orga/582
maria_cs: Thanks — I'll DM the attendee list. Also flag: renewal is warming up as a risk — propose adding an exec 30-min follow-up the week after to review outcomes.
sam_engineer: Draft agenda below — adds a few lab tasks I want to include:
```
Wed (90m):
  1) Goals & success metrics (10m)
  2) Migration demo: model pin + canary rollout (25m)
  3) Hands-on lab: pinning + small canary (35m)
  4) Q&A & next steps (20m)

Thu (90m):
  1) Cost baseline & token accounting (15m)
  2) Quantization + batching demo (25m)
  3) Autoscale policy workshop (35m)
  4) Action items & exec follow-up plan (15m)
```
leila_enable: Also suggest an optional 60-min office hours drop-in on Fri for leftover setups. Low-friction for engineers.
ajay_solutions: :thumbsup: I'll attach the poll to the invite thread. Plan emoji reactions for time slots (1/2/3) so Aster can vote.
maria_cs: Tentative targets: Wed 2026-04-01 11:00 PT and Thu 2026-04-02 11:00 PT depending on poll. I'll draft the prep email and share the playbook + sample prompts repo.
leila_enable: Please add a prep checklist: pre-shared model repo link, sample prompts, max_token budget, and expected infra limits.
sam_engineer: Uploading Terraform snippet + SG rules to the doc now. Will post link here when done.
ajay_solutions: Once poll closes I'll post final calendar invites and ping the Aster CSM and their engineers in the thread.
maria_cs: Thanks team — if anyone can't make it DM me. We need minimum two trainers per session. :rocket:
